GateEventsNote: AllDeposits (the stage-1 definition): the angular statistic over every assigned deposited-energy history against its largest-deposit crystal, acceptance = assigned / scored per crystal. SingleCrystal (theme 68 practice): the angular statistic over assigned single-crystal photopeak histories, acceptance = correctly identified / in-window single-crystal histories per crystal. Outputs carry both; the other set is reported beside the gate; changing this parameter is a new rule version, not a rerun.
Allocation: pitch / mask-detector distance / sqrt(12), per axis, radians
Gate: per (geometry, line, rate) cell over the confirmation seeds: every calibration of that line succeeds; upper one-sided 95% seed-cluster added angular RMS per axis of the rate cell <= allocation; pooled weakest assigned/scored acceptance of the line's ISOLATED held-out rows >= AcceptanceRatio * pooled median; the line is numerically bounded by the frozen development result. Rate cells report the rate-dependent loss as global throughput (pooled assigned / scored, and its ratio to the isolated row); it does not gate.
AddedError: atan((assigned crystal index - dominant deposited-energy crystal index) * pitch / D); all deposited-energy histories; measured global calibration window; one assigned acceptance per original scored hit; all conversions separately counted
Bound: Student upper interval on equal-seed MSE, square root; outer-cluster normal approximation; calibration failures or empty assigned seeds refuse, never drop
Numerical: Statistical noise of every per-seed table, flood and stream is inside the seed-cluster bound (each outer seed draws its own). Bias of the finite recipe, per axis, upper 95% seed-cluster value of each difference: calibration histories 2k/8k/32k per crystal (nested floods; the same held-out events and streams; difference of the added angular RMS), residual D1/(1-r), r = D2/D1 <= ContractionLimit; DOI bins 8/16/32 (expected-position proxy, max over crystals and depths, finest-level depth samples), residual D1/(1-r), r <= ContractionLimit; optical photons 100k/400k (two levels; residual D1/(1-PhotonContractionAssumed)). D1 = D2 = 0 gives residual 0; D1 = 0 < D2 refuses. A line is numerically bounded when every calibration level succeeded in every development seed, every contraction holds and optics + that line's calibration residual <= NumericalAllocationFraction * allocation on both axes.
Freeze: development alone never qualifies a cell. FreezeEligible when at least one (geometry, line) is numerically bounded; the frozen result records the bounded lines, and a confirmation cell of an unbounded line is refused. Single frozen candidate bypasses selection when the planner judges the margin clear; repair uses fresh REPAIR32 and new pins.
Method: LatticeGrowth (LUT v2) on the fine heads: density smoothed at BinsPerCrystal/8; local maxima >= 2% of the maximum; lattice grown ring by ring from the highest maximum within one nominal spacing of the flood centre of mass, each slot predicted from its assigned neighbours plus the local measured step, matched to the highest unused maximum within 0.4 step, accepted only with a 3-sigma counting-statistics valley to every assigned neighbour; exactly Nx x Ny filled, every neighbour pair 3-sigma valley, legacy monotone and regularity checks, watershed. Baseline (12 x 12): legacy LUT and legacy solve, byte-identical. No truth marker.
